title: Adipokines and Ghrelin Concentrations in Different Stages of Anorexia Nervosa
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to determine serum concentrations of adiponectin (ApN), leptin and ghrelin in different stages of anorectic patients and to evaluate their relationships between biochemical, hormonal and anthropometric parameters.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of anorexia nervosa for Group 1-3
* Constitutionally thin healthy subjects for Group 4

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medical or psychiatric diagnosis other than anorexia nervosa,
* History of gastrointestinal disease for Group 1-3
* History of eating disorder or gastrointestinal or psychiatric disease for control group
study_population: Patients with anorexia nervosa and constitutionally thin healthy subjects
